out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located near the prepline is blocked by boxes of food, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM relocated boxes of food away from hand sink to allow for easy access for employees.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: Avantico 1 Dr flattop refrigerator on prepline.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS instructed CFM to place ambient thermometer in side the Avantico 1 Dr flattop refrigerator on prepline.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: plastic squeeze bottles (oil, water), plastic containers of toppings (cookie crumble and powdered sugar, chocolate chips).
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS instructed CFM to label all food removed from original container with common food name, CAPO Deli Tysons (Inspection Date: 08/28/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Boxes of tomatoes and cheese stored on the floor inside the walk in refrigerator and main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated boxes of tomatoes and cheese to shelf inside was in refrigerator and shelf on dry storage shelves.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Container of metal spoons and forks were found displayed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward on prep counter on cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EHS instructed CFM to stored metal spoons and forks with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward in container.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device (“Y splitter”) on the water supply system (mop sink).
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM removed “Y splitter from mop sink).

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS texted CFM copy of written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the back kitchen is blocked by multiple stacked pallets stored directly in front, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM relocated pallets to back kitchen area away from hand sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored above RTE cooked pork and box of uncooked bacon inside the Kolpak walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs to bottom shelf inside of the Kolpak walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employee observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands (watch and gold bracelet) while preparing food on cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed CFM to remove watch and gold bracelet and wash hands before returning to prepping.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Avantico 1 Dr UR refrigerator ambient temperature was 52F in the front kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: CFM removed several blocks of cheeses and deli meats from the Avantico 1 Dr UR refrigerator to facilitate better air flow circulation throughout the unit. Unit ambient temperature was 41F after 5 mins.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device (unapproved “Y” splitter device) on the mop sink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: CFM agreed to remove one hose from the “Y” splitter. EHS advised of option of pressure bleeding backflow prevention device for future reference. CAPO Deli Tysons (Inspection Date: 03/03/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink in back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: CFM placed paper towels at hand sink.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed all the handwashing throughout the facility blocked by equipment, boxes, cart, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM removed equipment, boxes, and cart blocking access to hand sinks.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs stored directly above RTE meatballs in tomato sauce inside of walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated raw shelled eggs to bottom shelf of walk in cooler.

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Safe, Unadulterated & Honestly Presented
violations.observation: The shredded mozzarella cheese in the 1 door refrigeration unit was observed with blue-tinted contaminant inside of the food storage container.
violations.corrective_action: Cheese was discarded by PIC. Employees should be paying close attention to the state of the foods they are handling for service. Any contaminated foods should be discarded.

out_items.name: Proper disposition of returned, previously served, reconditioned and unsafe food

violations.title: Discarding Unsafe/Adulterated/Not Honestly Presented Food
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is unsafe, adulterated, or not honestly presented and shall be discarded or reconditioned:
violations.corrective_action: A food that is unsafe, adulterated, or not honestly presented shall be discarded or reconditioned according to an approved procedure.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: fried chicken, cooked eggplant, and sliced tomatoes observed in 2 door prep refrigerator around 47F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Foods were discarded. CAPO Deli Tysons (Inspection Date: 03/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: cannoli cream dated 3/2 observed in walk-in on 3/12/25.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day.
